thread:
Zoe: FYI we pulled a reconciliation exception: a Q4 committed prepay sold to three EMEA customers was invoiced in GBP but services delivered across Oct-Dec in USD-priced units. Need revrec path and FX handling. Ticket FIN-4991: https://tickets.redwood/FIN-4991
Marcus: Oof. Do we have the original invoices and the FX rates used at billing? Also any pricing experiment credits attached?
Zoe: Invoices issued 2024-10-05 in GBP. Services consumed Oct->Dec, invoices recorded as revenue in Oct (gross). Two customers had a promo A/B price test (engineered discount recorded as invoice discount) totalling GBP 7,500.
Lina: Per ASC 606, if performance obligation satisfied over time, we should defer and recognize over the service period. FX: amortize revenue in functional currency (USD) using prevailing spot rate at each reporting date for amortization. How were invoices booked originally?
Marcus: They were posted to 4000-ImmediateRevenue using the invoice date rate (booked in GBP and translated at invoice date). That likely overstated Oct revenue in USD.
Jen: Controller: we need an adjusting JE to reclassify to deferred revenue (liability) in GBP and then amortize monthly with translation to USD on each month-end remeasurement. Also include separate presentation for promotional test credits. Provide audit memo with rationale and FX policy.
Zoe: Proposed adjustment (GBP amounts):
```
Dr 4000-InvoiceRevenue GBP 96,000
Cr 3000-DeferredRevenue GBP 96,000
```
Amortize monthly (3 months) GBP 32,000 -> 4100-ServiceRevenue. Promo GBP 7,500 should be contra revenue on the amortization lines.
Lina: For USD GL we post the amortization amounts translated at month-end spot rates. FX remeasurement on the GBP liability will hit other income/expense (FX gains/losses) per policy. Document the expected FX hit amount in the close memo.
Marcus: Do we need a separate accrual for usage adjustments? Some customers had usage-metered overages in Nov that are billed in Jan. If so, we should accrue estimated revenue for services performed but not invoiced (SBNI).
Zoe: Good call. One customer has an estimated USD 4,200 of overage for Nov that wasn't invoiced until Jan. I'll add an accrual line: Dr 1300-Receivable Accrual USD 4,200 / Cr 4105-AccruedRevenue USD 4,200.
BillingBot: FIN-4991: JE draft uploaded by Zoe (status: pending review).
